correctness.rationale: C: For the extra ballot A>B>C, first-round Borda increments are (2,1,0) and pairwise margins change by one toward the added ballot. Case splitting all before/after lowest sets yields only old singleton A -> new tied lowest {A,B}, with s_B=s_A+1, s_C>=s_A+3 and margin B>C positive; or old tied {B,C} -> new singleton C, with s_B=s_C<s_A and margin B>A at least 2. All other singleton/pair transitions have a weakly preferred new winner or are excluded by nonunique winners. Independent exhaustive enumeration of 74,256 profile/added-ballot comparisons for n=0..11 confirmed iff; exactly six adverse n=11 cases, none earlier. The 12-voter type-II witness was independently rechecked at score level.
